purpose: Verify that the selected FrEDI_Data slices at the pinned 2026 commit are the same transport inputs embedded in the FrEDI v4.1.1 package object.
method: Loaded the pinned v4.1.1 sysdata.rda in R 4.4.2; compared Roads/Rail raw rows to stateData$data$data_scaledImpacts on sector/state/postal/model/variant/modelUnitValue; compared each scalar CSV to stateData$data$scalarDataframe on state/postal/year and scalarName. Numeric comparison was after R CSV parsing.
conclusion: All selected current FrEDI_Data transport rows align with the v4.1.1 embedded package inputs. The two nonzero maxima are below tolerance and reflect floating-point CSV serialization/parsing.
